cross_study_claim_transfer: forbidden: no metric from this study may be cited as evidence for a structured-E5 claim, or the reverse

corpus.company_selection: frozen hash rule; disjoint from E1-E5 and every prior validation cohort; not hand-picked
corpus.boundary_rule: section boundaries are part of the frozen protocol; a claim is only defined relative to a section

ground_truth.blinding: annotators never see model output, any score, any prediction, or the other annotator's verdict before recording their own
ground_truth.guidelines: frozen and published before annotation, with a worked example set; changing them after seeing model output would make the reference a function of the model
ground_truth.note: evidence_spans agreement is typically far lower than direction agreement; an aggregate kappa would hide the hard part

metrics.note: a model that abstains on everything scores perfectly on unsupported_claim_rate, so the pair is mandatory

instrument_validation.purpose: a metric for citation correctness is only meaningful if it can detect a known-wrong citation
instrument_validation.method: plant controlled defects into reference claims, then run the metric implementation over the injected set

systems.full: the complete Agent pipeline as shipped
systems.retrieval_only: evidence spans returned without claim synthesis
systems.evidence_removed: full, with cited spans stripped before judging; if citation correctness does not move, the metric measures self-consistency rather than grounding
systems.human_upper_bound: annotator A scored against the adjudicated reference

limitations: claim segmentation is partly subjective; kappa on claim_span is reported, not smoothed
the reference set is bounded by annotator time, so recall is measured against a human reference, not a complete one
planted defects validate the metric, not the annotators; annotator error is measured by kappa and remains a limitation
temporal-change labels exist only where a comparable prior filing exists
